interface.title: TACIT
interface.field: Qualitative social science research (interview analysis, here responsible-innovation studies)
interface.stage_of_work: Analysis: coding interview transcripts, checking coding reliability, synthesising themes and reporting
interface.what_it_is_for: Code interview transcripts against a literature-grounded framework (with optional model drafts), review every code with an audit trail, measure inter-coder reliability on a blind double-coded sample, cross-tabulate and group codes into themes, and export Excel, Word and Gioia-style outputs.

data.note: Loaded the 24 shipped synthetic English interviews (A01–P06) and their reference codings with the sidebar's 'Load selected' button (Loaded 24 of 24; 148 segments, 182 codes). The active framework was the built-in Responsible Innovation (AIRR, Stilgoe et al. 2013): 4 dimensions × 2 polarities = 8 codes. No model key was entered, so no transcript was coded in this run; all codes analysed are the shipped reference codings. My review edits went to a new file, demo_en_A01_reviewed_*.json; the shipped reference file was not changed. None of the test .docx files were uploaded.
